requiredWhen: delay_axis_quantity is stage_position. Specified in docs/model/delay-axis.md and argued in docs/decisions/conventions.md under the stage and the factor of two.
withoutThisField: The conversion from stage position to optical delay cannot be redone or checked, so a scan whose factor of two for a double-passed retroreflector was left out stays wrong by two on its time axis and every duration derived from it is wrong by two.
